# Third-party page template attribution

Retrieved 2026-10-06 from https://bowenchai.github.io/QuantVSR/:

- `quantvsr.css`: unmodified `static/css/index.css`.
- `bulma.min.css`: unmodified `static/css/bulma.min.css`.

The Hihaze title/authors/institutions/link block was adapted directly from the
QuantVSR HTML. The academic layout, typography and section organization were
adapted for Hihaze in `academic.css` and `index.html`. Original authors, project
links, results and affiliations were replaced; no analytics scripts were copied
into the active Hihaze page.

QuantVSR credits the Academic Project Page Template:
https://github.com/eliahuhorwitz/Academic-project-page-template
which derives from Nerfies: https://nerfies.github.io/ .

The template source declares Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . The adapted HTML/template styling
is distributed under that license. Research/dataset image assets retain their
respective licenses and are not relicensed by this template notice.

Bulma by Jeremy Thomas is MIT licensed:
https://github.com/jgthms/bulma/blob/master/LICENSE .
The MIT license notice is retained in `bulma.min.css`.

FlashVSR https://zhuang2002.github.io/FlashVSR/ is the reference for the method
text/figure structure and the two independently implemented image carousels.
